| | **〔此处转录不清〕** | |
| | The unnamed attended and was examined by | |
| | Dr. Patrick. Ryan had been for some time a patient | |
| | in the hospital being treated therein for | |
| | alcoholic addiction, he had, however, refused to | |
| | co-operate with the hospital authorities, having | |
| | repeatedly gone out without permission and invariably | |
| | returning under the influence of drink. Today, the | |
| | Dr. stated, Ryan had returned to the hospital following | |
| | one of these escapades and had created a disturbance | |
| | when he had been informed that certain debts incurred by | |
| | him at a bar had been presented at the hospital and paid | |
| | by the hospital authorities with money that Ryan had | |
| | left in their care. Dr. Patrick stated that he had already | |
| | informed Mr. A. Peterson, U.S. Marshall, of the | |
| | case, who had instructed him to request the Police of | |
| | Hongkew Station to take custody of the man for the night | |
| | and to bring him to his office at 9 a.m. 27/4/40. | |
| | J. Ryan is at present detained in the station and | |
| | will be taken before Mr. Peterson in accordance with | |

| | **〔此处转录不清〕** | |
| | 该无名氏到场并接受 | |
| | 帕特里克医生（Dr. Patrick）检查。瑞安（Ryan）曾长期作为 | |
| | 住院病人，在该医院接受酒精成瘾治疗，然而，他拒绝 | |
| | 配合院方，曾多次未经许可擅自外出，且每次返回时均 | |
| | 处于醉酒状态。据帕特里克医生称，今日，瑞安在 | |
| | 其中一次擅自外出后返回医院，当得知其在某酒吧欠下的 | |
| | 债务已由院方用其托管于院方的资金代为支付后，便大闹 | |
| | 一场。帕特里克医生表示，他已就此案通知美国法警 | |
| | A. 彼得森先生（Mr. A. Peterson），后者指示他请求虹口 | |
| | 警察局将该男子拘留过夜，并于1940年4月27日上午9时 | |
| | 将其带至其办公室。J. 瑞安目前被拘留在警局，并将按照 | |
